description: `accounts usage` for a codex-kind seat reads the seat's own CODEX_HOME session transcripts directly (limits.read_and_record_codex_usage, a `.jsonl` rollout file under sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/) — no herdr call, no prior dispatch needed. A single `token_count` record with the vendor's `rate_limits.primary.used_percent` is enough to classify remaining quota.
